focus.title: Cash fights, guard the pit
focus.action: After each won fight, hit the nearest enemy tower with a wave, and enter the Fangtooth pit only with three teammates.

16.4.call: Fangtooth went allied, but two separate plays cost four deaths: Grux killed Countess on the offlane, and Sparrow killed Phase, Khaimera and Kira after the take. Back off together once Fangtooth falls.

28.9.call: Phase was dead when the fight opened; Khaimera and Kira died, then Lt. Belica, though the enemy offlane inner fell. Down a support, skip the pit.

35.9.call: Lost 0-5 after the uncontested Primal Fangtooth: Kira fell first, Grux killed Lt. Belica on the offlane, then Khaimera, Phase and Countess died before Sparrow destroyed the Core. With the mid inhibitor down, hold the base as five.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Nine kills led the allied team, and farm ran 10.1 per minute on a 7.5 norm. Keep that farm pace, then bring the gold to every Fangtooth fight.
Five deaths: three to Sparrow, one to Steel outside any detected fight. When Steel and Sparrow both show on the duo lane, trade only beside Phase.
Offlane kills on Zarus and Grux were useful trips, but the allied duo outer fell soon after the Zarus kill. Before leaving the duo lane, confirm Phase can hold.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Nineteen wards on a 10.3 norm and 17435 healing, but Steel placed 26. Before each Fangtooth, spend the third Tranquility ward on the pit entrance.
Two deaths outside any detected fight: to Sparrow before the duo outer fell, to Grux before Primal Fangtooth. Before a Primal Fangtooth, arrive with Kira.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Two deaths, two kills on Grux, and 658 hero damage per minute on a 504 norm. Hold that survival standard when the next lane gets rough.
No kill or death credit in three mid fights after their offlane outer fell, with five assists overall. Once it falls, call split or group before the next mid fight.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Three kills on The Fey, no deaths to The Fey, 1061 hero damage per minute on a 743 norm. Hell of a mid; keep forcing that trade.
First blood on Grux on the offlane, then a death to Zarus there seconds later. After an early offlane pick, reset to mid at once.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Two deaths to Zarus came before the second Fangtooth, one outside any detected fight. Before a pit visit, confirm Zarus elsewhere on the map.
Gold ended 13.1k against 17.0k for Zarus with three items finished, while 10 wards beat a 4.7 norm. While behind on gold, fight only beside Kira or Lt. Belica.

matchup: Duo was Kira and Phase against Sparrow and Steel; the allied duo died twice before minute ten, the enemy duo never.
Sparrow killed Kira three times; Kira killed Sparrow twice and Steel twice.
Steel's RMB bash stuns and adds max-health damage; when Steel closes on Kira, save Shadow Glide for the bash.
build: Ashbringer and Imperator are two of the 58.6% winning core; Solaris never made the build.
Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic-attack hits; Zarus healed 24419, the most in the game.
Demolisher ignores a share of physical armor, a fit against Steel and Zarus, the game's two heaviest mitigators.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health physical damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero.
Xyris and Vermis are even at the top of the Kira carry field. Sound keep.
Serration with Breach is the best Vermis pair; the Serration and Melting Point run ranks second.
augment: Siphoning Purge makes Purge heal for a share of Purge damage dealt to heroes.
Lenore and Bringer Of Mercy are a toss-up at the top of the Kira carry field; Siphoning Purge ranks third.
Tainted Blade on Zarus and Grux cuts that Purge healing after physical hits.
crest: Eviscerator's Rending Strikes active grants attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage for a short window.
Eviscerator has too few Kira carry games to lead; Liberator leans ahead of Pacifier.
Eviscerator, Liberator and Pacifier all evolve from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: Solaris over Demolisher completes the winning core: an empowered, healing basic after each cast, giving up armor ignore.
Liberator over Eviscerator is the field-backed crest: a cleanse and shield, giving up the attack-speed burst.
Lenore over Siphoning Purge trades Purge healing for a Nevermore cooldown refresh on Shadow Glide.

matchup: Steel, the support opponent, finished 1/5/19; Phase killed Steel once, and the lone Steel kill was on Kira.
Steel's bash and R leap both stun, Steel's Q charge knocks back, and Grux's Q pulls and stuns.
build: On the full 51% winning core: Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves.
Enra's Blessing shields a nearby immobilized ally, a direct answer to Steel and Grux stuns.
Vanguardian gives nearby allies physical and magical armor, useful against Sparrow's physical damage.
eternal: Knell applies Rust on hero hits, shredding both armors and granting a share of the shred.
Support Eternals are unmodeled; Exarch is the only Phase support Eternal with enough games, the most played.
Frequency with Peal is the most-picked Knell pair; no Knell pair has enough games to rank.
augment: Psychic Support makes Essence Catalyst also restore the linked ally's missing mana.
Kindred Surge and Psychic Support are even at the top of the Phase support field. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's Grace active heals nearby heroes and adds brief damage mitigation; Visionary raises the ward cap to three.
Tranquility is the only Phase support crest with enough games, the most played. Sound keep.
improvement: No build change is proven; the winning core was complete.
Testing Exarch over Knell trades armor shred for attack speed and on-hit magical damage on healed or shielded allies.

matchup: Grux was the lane opponent; Countess killed Grux twice, and Grux killed Countess once.
Grux's Q shockwave pulls and stuns and Grux's R stuns; the Countess R suppresses.
Sparrow, Zarus and Grux brought physical damage, and Countess finished with no armor item.
build: Noxia is in the 55.8% winning core; Lifebinder never made the build.
Orb Of Enlightenment is the evolved Orb Of Growth, so the winning core's first item was in place.
Overseer makes the R deal more damage and heal from hero damage dealt.
eternal: Vesh turns ability damage on heroes into extra damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Vesh leads a toss-up with Aion in the Countess offlane field. Sound keep.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Sanguine Slash makes Blade Siphon hit harder and heal more against isolated targets.
Shadow Echo leans ahead of Sanguine Slash, the most played, in the Countess offlane field.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge active damages up to three nearby heroes each second and heals from the damage.
Soulbearer and Epoch are a toss-up at the top of the Countess offlane field; Tempest ranks behind both.
improvement: An armor item over Wraith Leggings answers three physical enemies, giving up bonus magic damage on low-health heroes.
Shadow Echo over Sanguine Slash is the field-backed swap: Shadow Slip damage repeats on swap, giving up isolated-target healing.

matchup: The Fey's R fly trap pulls attached heroes and stuns; The Fey's Q brambles slow.
Zarus and Grux each killed Lt. Belica on the offlane; Sparrow killed Lt. Belica twice.
build: On the 51.8% winning core: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings.
Caustica ignores a share of magical armor and hits harder on healthy, magic-armored heroes.
Amulet Of Chaos, finished last, cuts basic ability cooldowns on takedowns.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on casts and gold from spell damage to heroes.
Lotus is the clear best Eternal in the Lt. Belica midlane field; Aion has too few games to lead.
Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is the best Aion pair.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience every second.
Combat Veteran is the clear best Lt. Belica midlane augment. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer has too few Lt. Belica midlane games to lead; Epoch and Typhoon are a toss-up at the top.
Soulbearer and Epoch both evolve from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Lotus over Aion is the field-backed swap: random stat gains on takedowns and over time, giving up mana and spell gold.
Epoch over Soulbearer trades the shield and lifesteal for a stasis escape.

matchup: Zarus was the jungle opponent; Khaimera killed Zarus once and died to Zarus three times.
Zarus's R leaps at a hero and creates a coliseum, and Zarus's Q shield swing stuns.
build: Overlord is the only piece of the 56.3% winning core; Basilisk and Rapture never made the build.
Draconum adds physical armor, raises healing while dealing damage and heals on takedowns.
Zarus and Grux carry Tainted Blade, cutting Draconum, Judgement and E healing on Khaimera after physical hits.
eternal: Knell's Rust shreds physical and magical armor on hero hits; Frequency adds attack speed and ability haste per stack.
Lotus leads a toss-up with Nihil in the Khaimera jungle field; Knell has too few games to lead.
Frequency with Fracture is the best Knell pair; the Frequency and Peal run has too few games to rank.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Feral Ambush leans ahead of Jungle Invasion in the Khaimera jungle field.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Eviscerator leans ahead in the Khaimera jungle field; Judgement ranks third among crests with enough games.
improvement: Basilisk over Sky Splitter adds a second winning-core piece: armor shred on hero hits, giving up current-health hits.
Feral Ambush over Jungle Invasion trades jungle power for longer Ambush range.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

sparrow.loadout: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider), augment Endless Hunt, crest Liberator
fedBy: Endless Hunt (augment): Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,211 hero damage a minute, more than 80% of Sparrow carry players this patch (34% of the team's). The damage came from Manta Scythe, Scattershot, Tainted Rounds.
Inner Fire at rank 3: 105s base, about 95.5s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Spectra 10.
17 takedowns (12 kills, 5 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 44,805 hero damage, 34% of their team's, with +197 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10, Viper 8; against Khaimera (level 17: about 133 physical armor, 115 after penetration; took 18,797 physical damage from heroes, 57% of all hero damage they took) and Kira (level 18: about 118 physical armor, 100 after penetration; took 14,377 physical damage from heroes, 65% of all hero damage they took) that is about 8% and 9% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Viper (item): Against Eroded Heroes: Deal 10% increased On-Hit and Ability damage.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.

lt-belica.loadout: Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus), augment Combat Veteran, crest Soulbearer
fedBy: Amulet Of Chaos (Deadly Wish): On Takedown: Reduce your current Basic Ability Cooldowns by 65%.• Restore 35% of your Missing Mana.
lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 593 damage mitigated a minute, more than 86% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch.
Neural Disruptor at rank 3: 85s base, about 66.4s by the end (22% shorter) from 28 ability haste: Noxia 20, Soulbearer 8.
15 takedowns (8 kills, 7 assists) fed: Amulet Of Chaos (Deadly Wish).
Lt. Belica dealt 39,247 hero damage, 33% of their team's, with +595 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11, Amulet Of Chaos 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against The Fey (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 1 after penetration; took 11,605 magical damage from heroes, 63% of all hero damage they took) and Grux (level 18: about 62 magical armor, 9 after penetration; took 17,470 magical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) that is about 48% and 48% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.
Aion (Eternal): Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
Sustain: Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 2,137 healing recorded.

Lesson: Lt. Belica's penetration cut through: The Fey took about 48% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 49, about 1 after 31 flat + 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Caustica, Noxia. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 28 ability haste brought them back 22% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Steel, Zarus). We killed Lt. Belica 4 times.
Copy it? Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus): 53.5% in 172 Lt. Belica midlane games, above the hero's 51.6%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
